notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!We're excited to announce the full release of Supermarket Simulator!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/b0660f77d415e1c6956ce834acf768f5865ef46c.png"]
A Message from the Producer
Hi, I'm Yusuf (Cannias) Toptan, the creator of Supermarket Simulator. What began as a solo passion project—built in just four months—launched into Early Access on February 20th, 2024. Thanks to your incredible support, it didn’t just succeed—it went viral, sparked a new sub-genre, and became the project I set out to create.

Following the Early Access release, I quickly realized that to meet the growing expectations of our amazing community, I needed a team. So I built one. Together, we've spent the past year and a half shaping Supermarket Simulator into what it is today—and now, the full version is ready.

I wanted to take a moment to share this personal note with you, because this has truly been a remarkable journey from day one. Both the team and I are deeply grateful for your continued support. None of this would have been possible without you.

And this is far from the end. We’ll continue updating and improving the game based on your feedback. Most importantly, we’re already hard at work on the highly anticipated Multiplayer mode and console versions.

Thank you again for all the love and encouragement. See you in the next updates and games!


What's new:Online Orders & Delivery!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/17467d6f4a491a90f21056dfa3ef5823834e2f51.gif"]

Added Online Order system: Accept, package, and deliver customer orders directly.


Also...
Added Support for ultra-wide resolutions.

Added MacOS support.
Optimization
Optimized system memory and VRAM usage.

Introduced a more performant renderer for products and boxes.

Reduced CPU overhead for rendering.

Improved performance during random spikes.

Optimized decals, furnitures with screen, and world textures.

Improved nighttime rendering performance.

Support for ultra-wide resolutions.
 Visual Improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/0092b28d13ea75af7e4008d2bf4a034d7dd85c65.png"]

Updated furniture models and textures.

Updated product models and textures.

Updated tree models and world props.

Improved lighting quality overall and specifically for store lights.

Updated and optimized character models.

Added in-store LOD system for better store rendering performance.

Added SMAA and FXAA anti-aliasing options.

Introduced distance fog for improved depth perception.

Added bloom and improved post-processing visuals.

Added shadows for street lights.

Introduced store outdoor lighting for a more immersive world.
Fixes
Fixed multiple janitor-related issues.

Resolved vehicle collision issues.

Fixed issues at the gas station.

Fixed the light sweep effect on window cleaning.

Fixed various localization issues.

 
What's NextMultiplayer is coming soon
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/8fb884e95b3ecdf660f016429f431d39a7b32b52.gif"]
Console releases
The game is coming to Xbox & PlayStation this year!
And more...
QoL updates, fixes, improvements, DLCs, etc.


Thank you all! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/122a4bdecba327053fe91125b76cb0ee9dfb75a1.png"]

notes.title: Last Discount Before The Full Release
notes.notes:
📣 Hey everyone!

We're getting close to the full release of Supermarket Simulator — and we wanted to share our plans with you.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/152f0a4654ced4d2148faf704876ec7090e7bfbc.png

🛒 This is the final discount before the 1.0 update!

The current Early Access discount will end on May 12, 2025. After that, the price will increase to match the upcoming full version. So if you're thinking of jumping in, now is the best time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670630/Supermarket_Simulator/
Yes, we'll get rid of the AI art but we've been unlucky with the artists for months...

📆 The 1.0 update is expected to launch in about a month.

🔧 What are we working on for the full release?

We’re hard at work on two major features:

 Online orders & delivery around the town
 Performance optimization for smoother gameplay on all setups

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731615/5990844e4848157b15a7c7c481e87c15254a3f05.png

💡 We’ve got more exciting improvements planned as well — including new content and polish across the board.

The development of Supermarket Simulator is not going to stop with the full release. There will be more free content, fixes & polish updates, DLCs, and a HUGE surprise.

Thank you so much for your amazing support during Early Access.
You're shaping this game with us, and we can't wait to show you what's next.

Best,
Nokta Team

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello Supermarket Managers!

We hope you're as excited as we are about the upcoming release of Supermarket Simulator! Today, we have an important update to share.

After careful consideration and to ensure the best possible gaming experience
We've decided to move our release date to February 20th, 2024. This brief one-week delay will allow us to add some extra content and polish to Supermarket Simulator, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable experience for all our players.

We understand that changes in release schedules can be disappointing, but we firmly believe this short extension will significantly enhance your gameplay experience. Your support and understanding mean the world to us as we make these final adjustments.

Feel free to try the DEMO or Supermarket Simulator: Prologue
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772560/Supermarket_Simulator_Prologue/

We can't wait for you to run your own supermarket and create your unique retail empire.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We're almost there, and we promise it will be worth the wait!

Warm regards,
Nokta Games
